summary_rationale: Titan Company Limited passes the price-blind business-quality audit as a durable Indian consumer compounder (COMPOUNDER_PASS) with 22.1% 10-year median sales growth, zero equity dilution (₹89 Cr equity capital since FY15), 20.5% ROCE / 37.7% ROE, and ₹10,413 Cr cumulative 12-year Free Cash Flow (₹4,713 Cr in FY26). Five of six leading operational KPIs are healthy—led by 35% studded jewellery mix, ~11.7% ex-duty Q2 FY27 jewellery EBIT margins, 31% CaratLane growth, 16.2% FY26 Watches EBIT margins, and ring-fenced LGD positioning via beYon—while kpi_health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH due to elevated inventory days (222 in FY26), higher Gold-on-Lease/lease borrowings (₹27,638 Cr in Sep 2026), and ongoing Emerging Business losses.
